name: Vernon
source:
“Ah— yeah, guess so...
Well, I'll... do something about it...”

Unit: Offense Black, 5th Squad
Rank: Address

A squad leader who is currently missing. She is the only Address who was recruited after the formation of H.A.Z.E.

Granted special authority, the 5th Squad under her command is permitted to operate independently.
Her ability in close-quarters combat is overwhelming, rivaling even that of the Space ranks.
